_readme: Division Rivals settings: Weekly Score, 30-match cap and rank shares: FIFA 21 retail, ported from the Python server (21bf125, 56145ed).
The weekly reward options and the promotion rewards are tables since migration 131, edited in the operator panel (Modes, Rivals); a fresh
Loaded at server start and validated strictly (an invalid file stops the server).

weeklyScore.weekendLeagueCounts on (retail): every completed FUT Champions Weekend League match (not a quit, DNF or void match) adds weekendLeagueMatch to the Rivals Weekly Score whatever its result, and uses one of the week's matchCap counting matches, shared with Rivals; once they are used, neither mode adds Weekly Score. Off: Weekend League matches add nothing and use no counting match.
EA (help.ea.com FIFA 21 'Division Rivals', Nov 2020): weekly score, 30-match cap, division fixed per week, ranks by percentile, promotion rewards the first time a division is entered.
poolBelowClubs: a division with fewer clubs than this in a week ranks on one pooled server-wide percentile table (every club with a Weekly Score that week); 0 turns pooling off.
